stories.title: How did things get so bad for Aaron Rodgers and Mike McCarthy, and what's next?
stories.summary: Today's news shook the NFL, and ESPN's insiders share insights on the QB, the coach and their futures.

stories.title: Steelers cut Aaron Rodgers after QB rips Mike McCarthy in scorched-earth interview
stories.summary: The QB was waived after he said on "The Pat McAfee Show" that McCarthy sleeps through team meetings.

stories.title: Sources corroborate Rodgers' shocking McCarthy allegations: 'It's all true'
stories.summary: NFL sources have corroborated Aaron Rodgers' account of Mike McCarthy to ESPN reporters, confirming the star QB's allegations about the Steelers coach.

stories.title: Sources: McCarthy has Steelers' full support after Rodgers' bombshell interview
stories.summary: Mike McCarthy has the full support of the Steelers organization and will remain the team's coach after Aaron Rodgers' allegations, sources told NFL Network and ESPN.

stories.title: Rams' Kinchens ejected after hit on Watson leaves WR with concussion
stories.summary: Rams safety Kam Kinchens was ejected for a hit along the sideline that left Packers wide receiver Christian Watson with a concussion Wednesday night.
